_note: Synthetic. Every value here is an assumption. The cost of a stopped line-hour comes from docs/company-profile.md; the others are set for this scenario.

order_buffer_hours.basis: Assumption: a line keeps running this long on orders already loaded when the link to the office side is closed.

recovery_hours_if_encrypted.basis: Assumption: time to restore a line whose controllers and workstations were encrypted.

cell_stops_line.basis: Assumption: a disconnected cell stops its whole line.

lines.name: Line A (casting)
lines.restart_basis: Assumption, from the author's plant experience: a casting line cannot be stopped and restarted like other lines. An unplanned stop costs this many further hours before good output returns.
